summary: Board-certified primary care physician with 10 years of continuous full-time clinical experience across outpatient and urgent care settings at a large national health system. Skilled in comprehensive primary care, chronic disease management, preventive medicine, and multidisciplinary team leadership.

experience.title: Primary Care Physician
bullets: Provide comprehensive primary care to a panel of approximately 1,800 patients, diagnosing and treating acute and chronic conditions across the lifespan

Prescribe medications, administer vaccinations, and manage therapies for diabetes, hypertension, asthma, and hyperlipidemia, achieving documented improvement in A1c and blood pressure control for 70% of patients in the chronic care registry
Order, perform, and interpret diagnostic tests including EKGs, spirometry, and laboratory panels, and explain results and treatment plans clearly during shared decision-making visits
Direct and coordinate care activities of two nurses, one medical assistant, and rotating residents, standardizing intake workflows and reducing average visit cycle time by 15%
Counsel patients on diet, activity, hygiene, and disease prevention, and refer to specialists when clinically indicated

experience.title: Primary Care Physician
bullets: Delivered outpatient primary care services with an average of 20 patient encounters per day, collecting and maintaining medical histories, examination findings, and treatment documentation in the electronic health record
Monitored patient conditions and progress, reevaluating treatment plans at follow-up visits and reducing avoidable emergency department utilization among high-risk patients by 12%
Performed minor office procedures including joint injections, wound care, and skin lesion excisions
Collaborated with nursing staff and care coordinators to launch a preventive screening outreach program that increased colorectal cancer screening completion by 22%

experience.title: Primary Care Physician
bullets: Managed a full-spectrum primary care panel in a community clinic, diagnosing and treating illnesses and injuries and providing same-day access for acute concerns
Administered vaccinations and preventive care services, including annual wellness visits, and advised patients on lifestyle and disease prevention
Reviewed records, reports, and examination information to diagnose conditions and ordered appropriate laboratory and imaging studies
Supervised medical assistants and mentored two students during clinical rotations, coordinating daily team huddles to improve continuity of care

education.institution: a state university school of medicine
